rows.label: EXPERTISE

rows.clue: An unelaborated elementary awareness of stimulation

rows.label: FARE
rows.clue: An agenda of things to do

rows.label: WORKING RULE

rows.label: CONCLUSION
rows.clue: A position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration

rows.label: FINE ARTS

rows.label: FECUNDITY

rows.label: DISBELIEF

rows.label: PROTOTYPE

rows.label: DISARRAY

rows.clue: The science of mental life

rows.label: PORTRAYING
